name: Canvas to Body
brief: Show the full transformation arc in one fashion-led sequence: source painting, scan evidence, reconstructed garment, worn fragment in motion.
prompt: Premium fashion campaign source image, image-only, no readable text, no typography, no logos. A restrained art-translation streetwear scene that makes a painted artwork feel extracted into clothing. Start with a bone-background technical archive feel, then transition through optical scan evidence and reconstruction logic into a worn oversized garment on a real body. The garment should feel desirable first: premium streetwear silhouette, graphic placement, textile texture, confident posture, candid motion. Include city/studio/gallery context with concrete, glass, metal, shadow, and sparse near-black and oxidized red accents. Use the painting as source material through crop, projection, reflection, or overlay evidence. Clean, minimal, mysterious, premium, fashion-editorial, social-follow-worthy.
final_prompt:
Create one premium editorial source image for Brand Name Design.
The image will be used inside an Instagram carousel, but must contain no readable text.

Brand aesthetic:
- technical archive label, optical scan, reconstruction protocol
- bone/off-white, near-black, muted grey-brown, deep oxidized red accent
- premium, minimal, mysterious, system-like
- physical oil painting to digital reconstruction to wearable fragment
- fashion campaign energy: product hero, styled body, movement, textile texture, confidence, lifestyle context
- premium streetwear energy: oversized silhouette, graphic garment emphasis, city/studio/gallery setting, concrete/glass/metal textures, attitude, candid motion, product-as-identity
- inspired by big-brand campaign logic without copying any brand: emotional momentum, sport/style crossover, clean premium product desirability
- garment/object must feel desirable before the concept is explained
- no generic fashion ad, no generic hypebeast poster, no fake graffiti, no museum-only documentation, no neon cyberpunk, no glossy gradients, no bokeh, no fake typography

name: Fragment in Motion
brief: Make the wearable piece feel alive in motion, like an object moving through the city with art-origin residue.
prompt: Cinematic streetwear fashion campaign image, image-only, no readable text, no logos, no graffiti. A model in an oversized silhouette wears a reconstructed fragment garment while moving through a muted city/studio/gallery context. Show candid motion, strong body language, textile weight, and product-as-identity. The art-origin story should appear as source evidence projected or reflected nearby, like a scan-derived archive residue. Palette must stay premium and restrained: bone background tones, near-black, oxidized red, muted technical neutrals, with source-art color only from the painting material. Include concrete, glass, and metal textures, sparse composition, clean negative space, and a confident, aspirational feel that sits between art archive and premium streetwear campaign.
